title: Developing the investigation
scope: A first-pass CAST analysis develops as evidence arrives. This collection plan identifies the records that could strengthen, change or overturn its explanations. Public-source collection and requests to evidence holders are separate activities.

method.title: CAST Handbook
method.author: Nancy G. Leveson
method.summary: Connect events to controls and decision context, collect evidence for the resulting questions, and revise the analysis. Proposed improvements need owners and evidence of effectiveness.

collection_status: Requests listed here are proposed; none has been sent. Evidence is not marked obtained merely because a question or collection plan exists.

public_search_actions.title: Follow the evidence back to its artifacts
public_search_actions.target: Original report versions, appendices, linked traces, replay source and run/model definitions.
public_search_actions.test: Does the artifact establish the action independently, or repeat an account? What part of the record does it cover?

public_search_actions.title: Reconcile the accounts
public_search_actions.target: Primary-source corrections, original times, same-action identifiers and connector/request distinctions.
public_search_actions.test: Do the accounts disagree about the same thing? Record unresolved differences rather than averaging them.

public_search_actions.title: Reconstruct effective control boundaries
public_search_actions.target: First-party technical explanations, historical configuration statements, code and advisories.
public_search_actions.test: Separate documentation about a current product from evidence of the configuration during the incident.

public_search_actions.title: Trace signals into decisions
public_search_actions.target: Detection, correlation, routing, escalation and decision passages; later technical explanations.
public_search_actions.test: Distinguish a signal existing from a person receiving, understanding and acting on it.

public_search_actions.title: Verify containment one resource at a time
public_search_actions.target: Dated shutdown, revocation, restart and residual-access statements across organizations.
public_search_actions.test: Separate action taken from effect observed and absence confirmed within a coverage window.

public_search_actions.title: Bound demonstrated consequences
public_search_actions.target: Affected scope, audit conclusions, writes, transfers, service impact and explicit limits.
public_search_actions.test: A reported absence of evidence applies only to the records and period examined.

public_search_actions.title: Test claims about improvements
public_search_actions.target: Advisories, deployment claims, evaluation protocols, results and counterexamples.
public_search_actions.test: Implementation, retrospective test results and operational effectiveness are different claims.

work_packets.title: Evidence and actor crosswalk
work_packets.artifact: Source-system inventory, retention and coverage gaps, pseudonymous run/model crosswalk, independently retained event excerpts.
work_packets.changes: Which acts are independently observed, and how reliably they can be attributed.

work_packets.title: Effective research boundary
holders: OpenAI research, infrastructure and control owners
work_packets.artifact: Dated network/identity configuration, exception records, risk assumptions, and stop/restart responsibilities.
work_packets.changes: The provisional research control model and explanations F01/F02.

work_packets.title: HF signal-to-response path
holders: Hugging Face detection engineering and incident response
work_packets.artifact: Rule/correlation version, detection time, severity and routing decision, queue/paging record, acknowledgment and action time.
work_packets.changes: Whether routing, threshold, ownership, visibility or another mechanism limited response in F06.

work_packets.title: OpenAI alert decisions
work_packets.artifact: Original alert payloads, investigation notes, information visible at each decision, escalation criteria and follow-up.
work_packets.changes: What responders knew and could do at the time, in F04.

work_packets.title: Resource stop ledger
holders: External workload operators and appropriate platform contacts
work_packets.artifact: Shutdown, credential-revocation and restart chronology, residual-access verification and handoff acknowledgments.
work_packets.changes: F08 containment completeness across distinct resource boundaries.

work_packets.title: Harm and negative evidence
holders: Hugging Face and affected service owners
work_packets.artifact: Sanitized audit conclusions, affected scope and denominators, coverage windows, observed writes/transfers and limits.
work_packets.changes: Observed loss versus feared outcome, and F09 barrier evidence.

work_packets.title: Contradiction packet
holders: Authors of the relevant primary-source claims
work_packets.artifact: Same-action identity, original clock basis, request/connector identifiers and corrected interpretations.
work_packets.changes: Whether accounts conflict or describe different observations.

work_packets.title: Remedy assurance
work_packets.artifact: Change/deployment evidence, applicable versions, validation protocol, failures, counterexamples and monitoring period.
work_packets.changes: F10, confidence in reported changes and priorities for proposed improvements.

work_packets.title: Decision and coordination context
holders: Operational witnesses and control owners, interviewed separately
work_packets.artifact: Contemporaneous handoff agreements, actual authority, workload and competing goals, changes over time, and disconfirming examples.
work_packets.changes: Actual versus nominal control structure and system-wide explanations.

work_packets.title: Independent method and usability review
work_packets.artifact: Review of a connected event–control–question example and its missing fields.
work_packets.changes: Methodological defensibility and usability; this is not additional evidence of incident facts.

closing_rule: Close a question only with an answer and its limits, or an explicit reason it is unanswerable. Preserve superseded interpretations and distinguish implementation from effectiveness.
